cost_note: Elastic returns no usage or cost fields on _inference responses (top-level key is only the task type). Nothing in-band meters the calls; billing is console-side. The user confirms it in the Elastic console (same standing check as T0.6).
latency_note: curl timings are warm-connection; python-urllib timings pay a ~6.2s DNS stall per fresh resolution on this network (AAAA for this hostname times out; see lambo-elastic-embedder.json). curl does not wait for AAAA.
native_doc_latencies_note: per-call means over 8 INGEST calls; each pays the ~6.2s DNS stall (fresh urllib connection), so engine time is ~1s like curl

native_engine_knn.engine: HNSW approximate scores, not exact cosine; ranking is the comparable signal
native_engine_knn.note: same shape as the settled kNN leg: both reason phrases and all four same-line shirts rank above both distractors; p6 (the roomier cut) trails in both spaces
native_engine_knn.query: snug across the chest, pulls at the buttons (input_type=SEARCH; docs embedded with INGEST, exactly what Lambo sends)

native_exact_cosine_knn.note: exact cosine over the same vectors: r2 top, all fit items above both distractors (p5 0.1159, p6 0.1011)

native_unrelated_floor.note: same unrelated pairs as the settled contract's 0.45-0.60 floor; the native space sits lower and wider

plain_vs_typed_note: without input_type the pair collapses to 0.47; with INGEST/INGEST it is 0.677. Lambo always sends INGEST for documents and SEARCH for queries, so the Lambo path uses the good configuration; a hand-rolled client that omits the field gets the bad one.
settled_contract: kind=bge_m3, model=baai/bge-m3, dim=1024, via OpenRouter (testdata/elastic/hybrid-documents.json, research/elastic.md)
